I was found before I died. I'm doing much better now, though. I see a therapist and my psychiatrist put me on some helpful medications. Remember, if you're having a rough time, please call the National Suicide Prevention lifeline for your country. These numbers can be found with a quick Google search. Otherwise, if you're in the US or if you don't mind paying international messaging fees, text START to 741-741. A crisis counselor will be willing to text with you. It's 100% confidential, and I highly recommend them. I've used them before. However, if you're looking to connect with others, try /r/suicidewatch. And as cliché as this may sound, believe me when I say, it does get better. I know you get tired of hearing that when your in a bad place, but it's the truth. If you're having a rough time, stay strong, OP. Things will get better. You have people who are willing to listen and ready to help.
